summary: The change raises the standard (non-privileged) session idle timeout from 30 to 45 minutes in payments' policy.py and the matching policy-params.json. No product obligation governs standard idle timeout; the privileged idle timeout (15 min, SES-1) and audit retention (7 years, AUD-2) are untouched, as confirmed by passing control tests. All process obligations are satisfied: the ticket is approved, an independent change_approver and a control_owner (outside the author's team) both approved the head commit, CI passed on the final commit with zero skipped tests, and no prior ledger evidence lapses. The change is low-risk and properly controlled; acceptance is recommended.
